inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "A pixel art sprite sheet of seven small flying craft of two desert tribes, each one whole and separate with empty space around it, on a plain flat pale grey background, all side views. Top row: four different craft of the Bloodridge raiders, built from scavenged black metal plates in the shapes of ancient Egyptian sun boats, with glowing ember orange engines. Bottom row: three different craft of the Clarth hunters, built from pale sand shark bone on dark metal frames with red trims and glowing red engines. No sails, no masts, no oars, no wood. Rendered entirely in crisp, deliberately clustered pixel art. Modern high quality pixel art like Sea of Stars: bright, colourful and readable, never muddy.", "style_description": {"medium": "pixel_art", "art_style": "Authentic hand pixelled 2D game battle stage background. Visible square pixel clusters and stair stepped contours everywhere. Flat colour clusters, two to four shades per material. Crisp pixel edges without antialiasing. Clean readable shapes. No paint brushwork, no gradients except a dithered sky, no noise texture.", "aesthetics": "clean game sprites, readable silhouettes, coherent pixel clusters", "lighting": "Clear morning sun from the upper left, flat pixel colour planes.", "color_palette": ["#221c1e", "#403638", "#5c5052", "#ff8a30", "#ffcc80", "#e2d6ba", "#aa9c82", "#b0342c", "#3c3a40", "#ff5a3c", "#e2e6ec"]}, "compositional_deconstruction": {"background": "A plain flat pale grey background and nothing else: no sky, no clouds, no water, no ground.", "elements": [{"type": "obj", "bbox": [91, 17, 403, 250], riveted together, a row of glowing ember orange engine vents along its belly and an open flat deck, side view, facing left"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [91, 261, 403, 494], "desc": "a slim fast flying craft of the Bloodridge raiders: a narrow black metal hull with a pointed curled prow, two round engine pods hanging under it glowing ember orange at the back, three round black pods held under its belly, side view, facing left"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [91, 505, 403, 738], "desc": "a squat round flying craft of the Bloodridge raiders: a short deep hull of patched black metal plates, a dark round dome on its deck, one big round engine glowing ember orange at its stern and small fins, side view, facing left"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [91, 750, 403, 982], "desc": "a long thin flying craft
